table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = service.name,
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	doctorname=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=servicerheader.doctcode), 
	serviceocatcode=servicerheader.servicercatcode,
	username=users.username,  
	servicercode=dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode,   
	date=dbo.servicerheader.date,  
	dbo.servicerheader.headerno,
	dbo.servicerheader.discperc,   
	dbo.servicerheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.servicerheader.custcode,   
	remarks=dbo.servicerheader.remarks,
	dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc,
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice, 
	ServiceFlatDisc = ServiceRDetail.ServiceFlatDisc,
	Qty = dbo.servicerdetail.qty,
	servicerdetail_discperc = servicerdetail.discperc, 
	customername=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode  = servicerheader.Custcode),
	dbo.servicerheader.saleinvcode,
	dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode,
	Patient=(SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE ServicerHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	RegNo=(SELECT Patient.Regno FROM Patient WHERE ServicerHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	patientadd=(SELECT Patient.address1 FROM Patient WHERE ServicerHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	patientphone=(SELECT Patient.phone FROM Patient WHERE ServicerHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	usergroupname=(select  groups.groupname from groups,usergroups where  users.usercode=usergroups.usercode and usergroups.groupcode=groups.groupcode),
	patientage=(SELECT Patient.ageyears FROM Patient WHERE ServicerHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode)
	
FROM 
	dbo.servicerheader 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.servicerheader.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode),
	dbo.servicerdetail,  
	service,
	users
WHERE 
	( dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = dbo.servicerdetail.servicerinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.servicerdetail.servicecode = dbo.service.servicecode ) AND
	( dbo.servicerheader.admissioncode IS NULL ) AND
	(dbo.servicerheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc +  misccharges   , 0)
